origin.source_maturity: Spanda ADC rational recovery is documented DESIGN, not shipped implementation; new Python oracle implemented in this PR.

selected.arity: (x: exact rational, maximum_denominator: positive integer)->(closest exact rational, signed exact residual)
selected.behavior: For exact x and Q>=1, return reduced p/q with 1<=q<=Q minimizing exact |x-p/q| over all rationals. Break ties by smallest reduced denominator, then smallest signed numerator. Return residual r=x-p/q exactly; no float, no ADC uncertainty inference, no machine or physical T5 authority.

positives.result: p/q=-1; residual=+1/2 (tie chooses smaller signed numerator)

falsifiers: RATIONALIZE returns an arbitrary exact rational without enforcing Q, so it is not equivalent to a bounded recovery.
Returning a float or silently discarding signed residual violates exact representation.
Returning q>Q or any fraction with larger exact error violates best-approximation law.
Breaking Q=1 halfway ties differently from the declared denominator/numerator order.
ADC measurement uncertainty must not be inferred from the approximation residual.

dedup.derivable: A higher-order library program can enumerate candidate rationals using D8/D9 exact arithmetic; derivability does not establish duplicate semantic identity, but Core versus Core-Math ownership remains owner-review.
dedup.independence_test: Universal denominator-constrained closest-rational relation with explicit residual/tie is not the same observable contract as unconstrained RATIONALIZE; requires proof whether it deserves a 10-bit Core resident.

lib/search.lisp selects the first maximal-scored successor by a strict > comparison, preserving deterministic tie order, and minimax depth recursion. This is an observable deterministic fold/search law but appears derivable from D6 ordering + enumerating successors, not a justified new Core D10 resident.
hobby_review.positive_witness: Two equal scored legal successors A then B must select A; reversing their order may select B. Counterexample: unstable hash iteration destroys tie reproducibility.

hobby_review.interest: chess / pure transition plus reject safety
hobby_review.reason: WASM smoke witnesses initial 20 moves, deterministic E2E4 resulting FEN and rejection of illegal A1-H8 without changing terminal state. State preservation on invalid input is a strong language-level boundary candidate, but existing selected D10 UNDO and APPLY-JOURNAL-EVENT plus user D2 control must be deduped before any slot.
hobby_review.positive_witness: Apply a valid state transition => new position; reject invalid transition => previous state unchanged; no invented state. Falsifier: partial board mutation on error.
